issues.description: Field mismatch for Lecture.numberOfInscribedStudents: the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares numberOfInscribedStudents as int (lines 63-69), but the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declares it as long (line 7). The solution's getTotalNumberOfStudents() method is declared to return int (line 75) but computes numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents (long + int), which produces a long value and will not compile when returned as int. This inconsistency between the UML, the field type, and the method return type will confuse students and can cause a compilation error in the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute and related method signatures consistent. Preferred fix: change numberOfInscribedStudents in the solution to int to match the UML, keeping getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int. Alternatively, if large values are intended, update the UML and change getTotalNumberOfStudents() return type to long and any callers/tests accordingly (and ensure the addition uses long types).
